title: The Phoenix's Ashes/Quotes
summary:
"Sophie, I know you aren't comfortable around fire. Marching into a volcano isn't going to be easy."
- Dante Vale to Sophie Casterwill

"You won't see it. That's the point."
- Den Fears to Dante Vale, describing his idea

"Why do you think you have this ceramic rod? To row a gondola?! If you don't have something for me in an hour, you'll be digging without them!"
- Shauna to Silent Soldiers

"You know volcanoes. They just don't work without the right lighting."
- Lok Lambert to Cherit

"Sophie, 'Lost daughter rises from the red ashes!' You're the lost daughter! It's gotta be you!"
-Lok Lambert to Sophie Casterwill

"Dante's the type to find his own way out." 
- Montehue to Tersly

"Lok, I don't know when we'll have another chance to spend time like this. There is so much to do as a leader of Casterwills. Especially now" 
- Sophie Casterwill

"Sophie, you gave us a little scare back there at the Volcano, but I knew you could do it all along"
-Lok Lambert to Sophie Casterwill
